questions_to_append.topic: Part Library: when do the other Part Library refusals show?
questions_to_append.question: The spec renames six refusals that name the shared list (S12-R11). We can test "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted." and "Part Library entry not found." on screen. For the others, which screen action shows them, if any: (a) "Part Library entry not found" (no full stop); (b) "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}." and "... for part number: {part number}."; (c) "Part Library entry missing category." (a part request from an entry with no category); (d) "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."?
questions_to_append.options: For each: A) It shows on screen when you ... (please say how). B) Only from outside the screens (no manual test).
sources: PRD v33 §8 rows 'Part Library entry missing', 'Part request from a Part Library entry with no category', '... with a source other than Vendor'

questions_to_append.topic: Part Library: where the special order's cost shows
questions_to_append.question: S12-R14b now says a special-order result from two vendors uses the most recent delivery's vendor AND cost. Our test reads the cost in the Cost field after the result is picked in New Part Request. Is that where the cost of the result shows?
questions_to_append.options:
A) Yes, the Cost field fills with that delivery's cost.
B) It shows somewhere else (please say where).

questions_to_append.topic: Part dialog: a renamed part on an open work order line
questions_to_append.question: After a part is renamed, what number does a line that already holds the part (picked onto an open work order) show? The spec keeps the line (S13-R18) and lists the open work that takes the new number (S13-R19: purchase order lines, part requests, canned jobs, returns), but not work order part lines; the tech plan leaves those lines unchanged.
questions_to_append.options:
A) The line keeps the old number.
B) The line shows the new number.
questions_to_append.note: No case asserts either answer now (the 14 Oct S13-20 line that expected the old number was removed: no PRD sentence supports it).
